verdict.rationale: Preinstalled container tooling is a fair question for a developer-focused desktop OS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions Docker, Podman, LXD or any other container runtime shipping by default. Generic claims about IDEs, toolchains and the package archive imply extra installation steps, not out-of-the-box container support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use container tools out of the box with no additional setup required
